variants.name: Shader Plasma Emitter Calm
variants.description: Slow Plasma Emitter shader drift. Ambient whole-house texture for quiet sections.

variants.name: Shader Plasma Emitter Drift
variants.description: Mined default Plasma Emitter shader speed. Versatile whole-house texture for mid-energy sections.

variants.name: Shader Plasma Emitter Surge
variants.description: Fast, zoomed-in Plasma Emitter shader. Intense whole-house texture for peak energy moments.

variants.name: Shader Hex 3D Spiral
variants.description: Mined Hex 3D Spiral shader preset -- the second most-used shader on the corpus's whole-house "All" element (28 placements). Matrix-oriented: gives 2D matrix props a real GLSL alternative beyond the always-static Plasma Emitter default.

variants.name: Shader Creation Silexars
variants.description: Mined Creation by Silexars shader preset -- a slow, hypnotic generative pattern. Matrix-oriented: shares the same color-mode/intensity/offset knobs as Hex 3D Spiral (both use xLights' common shader-uniform naming), no new parameter schema needed.

variants.name: Shader Black Cherry Cosmos
variants.description: Mined Black Cherry Cosmos shader preset -- the third most-used shader on the corpus's "All" element (15 placements). Minimal-parameter cosmic texture, matrix-oriented.

variants.name: Shader Continua Variation
variants.description: Mined Continua Variation shader preset -- a fast-moving abstract pattern driven almost entirely by the shader itself (no custom uniforms mined). Matrix-oriented.

variants.name: Shader xLights Fractal Audio
variants.description: Mined "xLights Audio - fractal audio.fs" preset -- the officially-bundled xLights shader (not a third-party community one), which integrates with the sequence's own xLights color palette rather than a hardcoded internal scheme. Audio-reactive and naturally sparse/dark in its quiet regions, so Normal blend still reads as enhancing whatever's beneath rather than fully blocking it (user-confirmed 2026-07-20). 148 placements across the user's own corpus, 95% explicitly Normal blend.

variants.name: Shader Fly Through
variants.description: Fly Through shader -- a fast-moving forward-tunnel pattern. Live-tested (2026-07-26): responds to C_SLIDER_Color_HueAdjust (baseline hardcoded red, ~0deg -- see _HUE_RESPONSIVE_SHADER_BASELINES in xsq_writer.py).

variants.name: Shader Audio Surf
variants.description: Audio - Audio Surf shader -- an audio-reactive waveform trace. Live-tested (2026-07-26): responds to C_SLIDER_Color_HueAdjust (baseline blue, ~245deg -- see _HUE_RESPONSIVE_SHADER_BASELINES in xsq_writer.py). Needs real media/audio loaded in the sequence to render meaningfully -- looks flat against silence.

variants.name: Shader Electrocardiogram
variants.description: Electrocardiogram shader -- a dim EKG-style pulse trace. Live-tested (2026-07-26): renders very dim and achromatic regardless of C_SLIDER_Color_HueAdjust -- needs a colored layer beneath with a Mask blend to theme-match (see tags.requires_color_mask).

variants.name: Shader Warp Kaleidoscope Tile
variants.description: Warp Kaleidoscope Tile shader -- tiles/mirrors whatever base effect renders beneath it on the layer below, rather than carrying its own color. Two failed live tests rendered nothing; root cause (user-confirmed, 2026-07-26) was too few active palette colors on the base layer, not the base effect's own type -- both Single Strand (2 colors) and Butterfly (3 colors) render correctly underneath it once given a real multi-color palette. Must be layered above (layer 0) any base effect on layer 1 with at least 2 (ideally 3) active palette colors -- a base with 0-1 active colors renders the whole stack flat white. Parameter values below are the verified-working production settings.

variants.name: Shader Warp Vincent'sStorm
variants.description: Warp Vincent'sStorm shader -- distorts/swirls whatever base effect renders beneath it on the layer below, rather than carrying its own color. Live-tested (2026-07-26) over a Butterfly base with 3 active palette colors: renders correctly, the base's own rainbow palette carries through the distortion. hue_adjust on the warp layer itself has no separate effect -- recolor the base layer beneath instead. Must be layered above (layer 0) a base effect on layer 1 with at least 2 (ideally 3) active palette colors -- a base with 0-1 active colors renders the whole stack flat white.

variants.name: Shader Inner Dimensional Matrix
variants.description: Mined InnerDimensionalMatrix shader preset -- the single most-used shader in a real 392-song corpus scan (381 placements, 13 songs; see docs/shader_corpus/INDEX.md, aggregated stats only, no per-song data). A fast strobing/flashing generative matrix pattern. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable) -- verify before relying on it in production.

variants.name: Shader Hex Vortex
variants.description: Mined Hex Vortex shader preset -- second most-used shader across the corpus (263 placements, 19 songs, the broadest song coverage of any shader outside the existing top picks). A rotating hexagonal vortex, matrix-oriented like Hex 3D Spiral. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Liquid Fire
variants.description: Mined LiquidFire shader preset (192 placements, 8 songs). A flowing molten/fire texture, most often layered with a Bottom-Top or reveal-style blend rather than plain Normal (58/192 masked placements) -- treat as an accent layer over a colored base rather than a standalone wash. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Great Ball of Fire
variants.description: Mined Great Ball of Fire shader preset (143 placements, 7 songs). A dense, fast-rotating fireball texture; short median placement duration (0.9s) suggests it's used as a quick accent rather than a sustained wash. Frequently blended with True Unmask (21/143) -- pair with a colored base for best results. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Tie Die
variants.description: Mined Tie Die shader preset (265 placements, but concentrated in only 5 songs -- weigh this one's popularity lower than its raw count suggests). A slow-rotating psychedelic swirl. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Draw Line
variants.description: Mined Draw Line shader preset (348 placements, but concentrated in only 6 songs -- weigh this one's popularity lower than its raw count suggests). Draws a single animated line; the corpus's real placements drive both endpoints through per-placement value curves (point1X/Y, point2X/Y), which our generator does not currently emit (value curves are disabled -- see the 'Value Curves Integration' TODO in CLAUDE.md). Without them this preset renders as a static line at a fixed position rather than the sweeping motion the corpus shows -- confirm this looks acceptable before shipping it into a rotation pool, or hold it until value curves are wired up. Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Zoom Loop
variants.description: Mined Zoom Loop shader preset (163 placements, 14 songs). A forward-tunnel/starfield loop similar in feel to Fly Through but self-contained (generates its own pattern rather than distorting a base layer). Not live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable).

variants.name: Shader Warp Parallax
variants.description: Mined Warp Parallax shader preset (190 placements, 16 songs). Distorts/tiles whatever base effect renders beneath it, like the other Warp-family entries in this file -- does not carry its own color. Must be layered above (layer 0) a base effect with at least 2 (ideally 3) active palette colors, per the Warp Kaleidoscope Tile / Warp Vincent'sStorm precedent (a 0-1 color base renders the whole stack flat white). NOT live-tested this session (xLights automation service unreachable) -- Warp-family shaders have previously rendered blank on a first attempt due to an undercolored base, so verify live before shipping.
